abstract: One-section-per-gesture scroll engine on Lenis (wheel with trackpad-flick debounce, touch, keyboard, hash, resize, tall sections, inner scrollers) plus scroll-driven CSS 3D tilt panels and fade-up reveals. Includes a no-build demo, unit-tested pure logic, DevTools samplers, an easing fitter, and a strict Measured / Derived / Unverified split: the reference page's tilt driver and WebGL canvas were not identified.
